settings.heading: The unstructured blazer.
settings.subhead: Made in our own factory, in seven fabrics. From €490.

settings.heading: Versatile by design.
settings.body: One construction, seven fabrics. The same blazer worn to a board meeting or a Saturday lunch — what changes is the cloth.

settings.heading: Made in our factory.
settings.body: Our factory in Central Portugal has been making outerwear since 1981. 30,000 garments a year, for European brands you’d recognise in the best stores on the continent.

settings.heading: Honest from the start.
settings.body: No shoulder padding, no canvas, no lining. Exposed seams bound by hand. The cloth from VBC, Reda, Drago, and Dormeuil — mills that have been weaving since the seventeenth century.

settings.heading: 44 years making what other brands outsource.
settings.body: Our factory in Central Portugal has been making outerwear since 1981. 30,000 garments per year, for European brands you’d recognise in the best stores on the continent. In 2026, we put our own name on the label for the first time.

settings.heading: A free 30-minute consultation.
settings.body: Talk to one of our advisors about fabric, fit, or anything you want to know before you order. No commitment, no upsell — just the conversation that gets the blazer right.
